experimental_design: OECM-1 cells were treated with cetuximab (500 μg/mL) for 30 passages over more than 2 months, and samples from different passages were collected for RNA sequencing (Table S3) and proteomic analysis (Table S4)
factor_value: treatment duration (early, middle, and late passages)

upregulation of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) and inflammatory response genes in early passages, followed by the emergence of EMT in middle passages and the enrichment of metabolism and DNA repair pathways in later passages
